Spot is owning the units on an exchange ledger or in a token contract. It is not a bet on a number. It is inventory.

By the end of this lesson you should be able to teach the title — What spot actually is — without a marketing slide.

Spot is owning the units on an exchange ledger or in a token contract. It is not a bet on a number. It is inventory. Intermediate treats this as an object with a contract, a function, and an explorer row. If you cannot point at those, you have a vibe. Global learners get the same objects.
